# XFree.in — Free Developer, SEO & AI Micro-Tools

> XFree.in publishes focused browser-based developer utilities, technical SEO tools, formatters, converters, and clearly disclosed AI assistants.

## Meta
- Version: 1.0.0
- Last Updated: 2026-09-06
- Capability Schema: https://www.xfree.in/capabilities.json
- Full Corpus: https://www.xfree.in/llms-full.txt

## Primary Sections

- [Home](https://www.xfree.in/): Search and browse the published tool directory.
- [Guides](https://www.xfree.in/guides): Reviewed documentation connected to published tools.
- [How It Works](https://www.xfree.in/how-it-works): Processing modes, browser execution, and optional cloud handoffs.
- [Pillars](https://www.xfree.in/pillars): 50 developer and SEO topic pillars; only pillars backed by published tools enter the sitemap.
- [Roadmap](https://www.xfree.in/roadmap): 600 planned concepts on a noindex discovery page; this is not a count of live tools.
- [Contribute](https://www.xfree.in/contribute): Open-source contribution workflow, publication gates, and safe good-first-issue process.
- [InstaServer](https://www.xfree.in/instaserver): Free, open-source MCP server that deploys app containers on your own machine — no account, no rate limit.
- [JSON Tools](https://www.xfree.in/json-tools): Hub of 18 free browser-based JSON tools — format, validate, minify, convert, sort, and inspect.
- [OpenAPI](https://www.xfree.in/openapi.json): Machine-readable description of the public XFree API surface.

## Categories

- [Developer & Data Tools](https://www.xfree.in/dev-data): Formatters, validators, debuggers, regex, encoding, converters
- [Web & SEO Tools](https://www.xfree.in/web-seo): Sitemaps, meta tags, schema, crawl, performance, accessibility
- [AI & Automation Tools](https://www.xfree.in/ai-auto): Prompt engineering, LLM tools, agents, RAG, MCP workflows
- [Media & Documents Tools](https://www.xfree.in/media-docs): Image, video, audio, PDF, documents, spreadsheets, markdown
- [Security & Privacy Tools](https://www.xfree.in/security): Hash, passwords, JWT, DNS, HTTP, certificates, encryption
- [Business & Productivity Tools](https://www.xfree.in/business): Text, writing, calculators, finance, marketing, productivity

## Published Tools

- [XML Sitemap Generator & Validator](https://www.xfree.in/tools/xml-sitemap-generator): Generate valid Google & Bing XML sitemaps with priority, changefreq, lastmod, and automatic chunking for large link sets.
- [Robots.txt Generator & User-Agent Rule Tester](https://www.xfree.in/tools/robots-txt-generator): Create valid robots.txt directives for search engine crawlers, test path allowance rules, and specify XML sitemaps.
- [Meta Tag & Open Graph Social Card Preview](https://www.xfree.in/tools/meta-tag-generator): Generate meta title tags, meta descriptions, and Open Graph / Twitter Cards with real-time Google SERP and social card previews.
- [Schema Markup Generator (JSON-LD Structured Data)](https://www.xfree.in/tools/schema-markup-generator): Generate valid Schema.org JSON-LD structured data for WebSite, Organization, SoftwareApplication, FAQPage, Article, and Breadcrumbs.
- [JSON / XML Formatter, Validator & Tree Viewer](https://www.xfree.in/tools/json-formatter): Format, validate, repair, minify, and inspect JSON/XML data with interactive tree views and error location diagnostics.
- [Regex Tester & Interactive Match Explainer](https://www.xfree.in/tools/regex-tester): Test regular expressions live with match group breakdown, string replacement previews, and flags (g, i, m).
- [Password Strength Checker — Free Security Tool](https://www.xfree.in/tools/best-free-password-manager): Generate strong passwords, check password strength, and learn password security best practices. 100% free browser-based tool.
- [Convert JPG to PDF — Free Online Converter](https://www.xfree.in/tools/convert-jpg-to-pdf-free): Convert JPG, PNG, and other images to PDF documents instantly in your browser. No upload, no signup, free forever.
- [Bulk URL Extractor & Sitemap Generator](https://www.xfree.in/tools/bulk-url-extractor): Extract URLs from massive raw text or HTML, clean, deduplicate, filter by domain, and generate valid XML Sitemaps with Sitemap-Index splitting.
- [Cron Expression Generator & Human Translator](https://www.xfree.in/tools/cron-expression-generator): Generate standard 5-part cron schedule expressions, view plain-English explanations, and calculate upcoming execution times.
- [Base64 Encoder/Decoder & JWT Token Inspector](https://www.xfree.in/tools/base64-encoder-decoder): Safely encode and decode Base64 strings, UTF-8 text, Base64URL parameters, and inspect OAuth JWT headers, payloads, and claims.
- [URL Slug Generator & Campaign UTM Parameter Builder](https://www.xfree.in/tools/url-slug-utm-builder): Clean title strings into SEO-friendly URL slugs, and build campaign URLs with UTM parameters (source, medium, campaign, term, content).
- [AI Detector — Free AI Content Checker](https://www.xfree.in/tools/ai-detector-free): Analyze any text to detect if it was generated by AI (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, etc.) using pattern analysis and statistical heuristics. 100% free, no signup.
- [Free PDF Editor — Edit PDF Online](https://www.xfree.in/tools/free-pdf-editor): Edit PDF text, annotate, highlight, and add comments directly in your browser. No software installation, no signup, completely free PDF editor.
- [Free Video Downloader — Download Videos Online](https://www.xfree.in/tools/free-video-downloader): Download videos from popular platforms. Enter a video URL and get download links for various quality options. Free, no signup required.
- [Free Photo Editor — Edit Images Online](https://www.xfree.in/tools/free-photo-editor): Edit photos directly in your browser. Crop, resize, adjust brightness, contrast, saturation, and apply filters. No software to install, completely free.
- [Coding Practice Platform — Learn to Code](https://www.xfree.in/tools/free-coding-practice-sites): Practice coding with interactive exercises, challenges, and immediate feedback. Learn JavaScript, Python, and more with our free browser-based coding practice environment.
- [Cloud Storage Comparison — Free Options Guide](https://www.xfree.in/tools/best-free-cloud-storage): Compare the best free cloud storage services: Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, and more. Find the right free storage solution for your needs.
- [Mobile Device Tester — Responsive Design Checker](https://www.xfree.in/tools/free-mobile): Test your website or app on virtual mobile devices. Preview on iPhone, Android phones, and tablets. Check responsive design and mobile UX.
- [Free Browser Games — Play Instant Games Online](https://www.xfree.in/tools/free-online-games): Play free browser games instantly. No downloads, no signup. Memory matching, puzzle games, and more. Fun mini-games during breaks.
- [VPN Guide — Free vs Paid Security Comparison](https://www.xfree.in/tools/free-vpn): Learn about VPN technology, compare free vs paid options, and understand when a VPN genuinely protects you. Educational security guide.
- [WeTransfer Alternatives — Free File Transfer Guide](https://www.xfree.in/tools/wetransfer-free): Compare WeTransfer alternatives for free file sharing. Learn about SendAnywhere, Filemail, and other free options. Transfer large files without paid subscriptions.
- [Canva Alternatives — Free Design Tools Guide](https://www.xfree.in/tools/canva-free): Compare Canva alternatives for free graphic design. Find the best free design tools for social media graphics, presentations, logos, and more.
